movie.title: A House Most Haunted
movie.overview: When a man clears out his childhood home to put on the market, he and his friend discover his parents' past seance records and hypnosis journals - awakening something that should have stayed buried.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: While clearing out his childhood home to prepare it for sale, a man and his friend accidentally unleash an ancient supernatural force after uncovering his parents' forgotten seance records and hypnosis journals.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Tasked with clearing out his childhood home to put it on the market, a man returns to the property alongside a close friend. Their routine cleanup takes a dark turn when they discover a hidden stash of his late parents' chilling seance logs and hypnosis journals. As they delve into the shocking records, they inadvertently awaken a long-dormant entity that was never meant to be disturbed. trapped inside, the duo must face the terrifying secrets of his family's past before the malignant force consumes them.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Preparing his childhood home for the real estate market seems like a straightforward, if emotional, task for a man grieving his past. To help ease the burden, he invites a friend along to clean out the old house and pack away remaining belongings. While searching through a neglected space in the house, they stumble upon a dusty collection of his parents' private seance records and detailed hypnosis journals. Curiosity quickly gets the better of them, prompting them to read through the unsettling accounts of occult experiments conducted years ago. Unbeknownst to them, reviewing the ritualistic notes and audio logs serves as a key that unlocks a long-sealed portal within the home. A sinister supernatural presence, which had been bound and buried by his parents, suddenly reawakens and manifests throughout the property. The atmosphere violently shifts as malevolent phenomena lock the two friends inside, cutting off any escape. Distrust and terror grow as the entity uses the house's history and psychological manipulation to turn the friends against each other. Ultimately, they must decipher the final entries in the hypnosis journals to find a way to banish the vengeful spirit before it destroys them both.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A House Most Haunted follows a man who returns to his childhood home to prepare the property for sale. Joined by a close friend to assist with the arduous task of packing up decades of memories, the routine chore quickly unravels when they uncover a secret collection of his late parents' belongings. Tucked away from sight are detailed hypnosis journals and disturbing audio recordings of spiritual seances conducted long ago. Driven by curiosity, the pair begins piecing together the unusual rituals his parents performed, unaware that the records hold more than just historical notes. As they delve deeper into the family's dark obsession with the occult, they inadvertently trigger an ancient, malevolent force that had been kept dormant for decades. Trapped inside the increasingly hostile environment, the two must unravel the true extent of his parents' psychological and supernatural secrets to survive the nightmare they have unleashed.

story_structure.climax: Tensions and supernatural dangers reach a critical peak, forcing the pair into a direct confrontation with the presence possessing the home.
story_structure.conflict: The pair uncovers his parents' old séance records and hypnosis journals, inadvertently triggering paranormal activity that was long dormant.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the encounter, the house falls quiet, leaving the surviving protagonist to process the haunting revelations about his family's past.
story_structure.introduction: A man returns to his childhood home with a friend to clear it out and prepare the property for sale.
story_structure.risingAction: Unsettling phenomena escalate throughout the house as the two delve deeper into the journals, struggling to comprehend the true nature of the force they have awakened.
